name: code-view
title: Code View
summary: Code on its own, with line numbers: a listing, a diff, or an editor.
description: The code itself, with no frame, to place anywhere: an editor pane, a diff view, the body of a Code Block. A gutter of line numbers as wide as the widest number, then the code in mono at a 20px line height with light syntax colouring (keywords, strings and numbers, function calls), or lines already highlighted elsewhere. A diff shows one gutter, a green / red accent bar, a row tint and word-level add / del highlights. A current line is tinted across the gutter and the code. Long lines wrap (wrap) or the code scrolls sideways under a gutter that stays. Its height is the code's, a fixed height, a cap past which it scrolls, or its container's (fill). The first frame is plain markup, complete and server-rendered. Then, for a listing of value, CodeMirror 6 takes its place (a dynamic import, after the first frame): read-only, a view that folds by indentation, finds (a compact widget floating over the code), scrolls with the keyboard and copies; editable, a code editor with undo history, find and replace and several cursors. It looks exactly like the plain listing, which it replaces without moving a pixel: same font, line height, gutter, colours, current-line tint and insets. A diff and lines highlighted elsewhere stay the plain listing: CodeMirror cannot show trusted HTML lines, and a diff is never editable. CodeMirror now loads wherever such a listing is shown (its packages are installed with the component). In a long listing it draws only the lines near the view, so the browser's find-in-page reaches only those; the view's own find (Mod+F) reaches every line. Every listing but a diff keeps a 12px fold column after the gutter's hairline, where CodeMirror draws its fold markers, so the code starts at the same place before and after it arrives, and turning editable on or off moves nothing.

anatomy.description: The box: surface fill, no frame, no radius, no shadow; the font, 20px line and colour of the code; code reads left to right (direction: ltr) in every page. Carries --fndn-code-view-height (height) and --fndn-code-view-max-height (maxHeight); fill makes it as tall as its container.

The plain listing's scroller, 12px block inset: the first frame, and what a diff or highlighted lines always show. While the code overflows it is a focusable role=region named by label (code-view.logic.ts watchOverflow). Gone once CodeMirror shows.
Grid: the gutter column (as wide as the widest number) + the code; rows are subgrids
One line. A diff row is tinted by its kind (ctx, add, del). The current line is tinted (hover) and carries aria-current="true".
Diff only: the 3px accent bar of an added (green) or removed (red hatch) row, in the gutter
Line number: 2xs, ink-3 (ink on the current line), right-aligned on the gutter's hairline, not selectable. A diff shows the new number, or the old one on a removed row.
Diff only: an added or removed run of words, tinted
A syntax colour (kw, str, fn) from the light tokenizer (code-view.logic.ts tokenize); the editor marks the same runs with the same classes
A listing of value only, never shown: the Phosphor caret CodeMirror copies into its fold markers

A listing of value only (not a diff, not highlighted lines): where CodeMirror (an EditorView, read-only or editable) is mounted. While it loads it lies over the plain listing, invisible, at the same size; then it takes the listing's scroll position and the listing goes. Everything inside is CodeMirror's own markup, given the listing's look by code-view.editor.ts.

While find is open (Mod+F, in a CodeMirror view, read-only or editable): the find widget, floating over the code at its top end corner (8px clear), so opening it never pushes or scrolls the code. The popup's surface, shadow and radius, 4px inset; at a narrow width it spans the view less 8px each side. It runs on CodeMirror's own search state, commands and keys.
Row 1: the replace caret (editable only), the find field, the count, Previous, Next, Close. Row 2, editable only, while the caret is open: the replace field, Replace and Replace all.

A Button (ghost, xs, square, muted) with a right caret that turns down while the replace row shows (aria-expanded), marked data-code-view="search-expand". The replace row is hidden each time find opens. Editable only.

An InputGroup (sm, mono) named Find, marked data-code-view="search-field" on its input, with three square Toggles (ghost, xs, muted) in its end: Aa match case, ab match whole word, .* regular expression, each named and tipped by its tooltip. It takes the focus, its text selected, when find opens and on Mod+F.

"3 of 12" (the match the selection is on), "12 results" when it is on none, "No results", or nothing while the query is empty; xs, ink-2, tabular, as wide as "No results" so the row keeps still. A polite role=status, so the count is announced.
An InputGroup (sm, mono) named Replace, marked data-code-view="replace-field", lined up under the find field; then Replace and Replace all, ghost xs Buttons.

value.description: The code, lines separated by \n (an empty value is one empty line; a trailing \n ends in an empty last line, as in an editor). Editable, it is the editor's text: an edit reports it (valueChange); a value set from outside replaces the text and the caret keeps its place.

highlighted.description: Lines already highlighted elsewhere (shiki and the like), as trusted HTML, one string per line; shown instead of value's rows, always as the plain listing (CodeMirror cannot show trusted HTML lines). Display only: editable shows value with the tokenizer's colours instead.

diff.description: A unified diff, shown instead of value, always as the plain listing. A diff is never editable and has no current line.

label.description: The accessible name: of the scroll region while the listing overflows, of the editor's text box (a file name or path).

editable.description: A code editor on value (CodeMirror 6, loaded now): typing, undo / redo, find and replace, several cursors, folding by indentation. Tab indents; Escape then Tab leaves. Ignored with diff.

currentLine.description: The current line, 1-based: its row is tinted (hover) across the gutter and the code, its number turns ink, and it is kept in view (the code scrolls just enough, at once; the page never scrolls). Read-only, only a line the host gives is tinted; with none, nothing is. Editable, it is the caret's line, line 1 unless set: moving the caret reports it (currentLineChange), and a new value puts the caret at the start of that line. A diff has none.

wrap.description: Long lines wrap (as in documentation): a wrapped line keeps its number on its first row. false: a line never wraps; the code scrolls sideways and the gutter (with a diff's accent bar) stays at the inline start over an opaque fill, as an editor's does.

height.description: Fixed height in px: the box keeps its size whatever the code (loading, switching files).

maxHeight.description: Height in px past which the code scrolls.

fill.description: As tall as its container (give the container a height): the code scrolls inside. Layout only, nothing measured, so it follows every resize.

labels.description: The editor's words, for translation: { find, replace, toggleReplace, next, previous, close, matchCase, wholeWord, regexp, replaceOne, replaceAll, count, results, noResults, fold, unfold, folded }; in count and results, {current} and {total} stand for the numbers.

events.valueChange: (value: string) after every edit made in the editor (typing, paste, undo); never for a value set from outside
events.currentLineChange: (line: number) when the caret moves to another line in the editor

a11y.role: textbox, multi-line, aria-readonly when read-only (CodeMirror's view); region (the plain listing of a diff or highlighted lines, while it scrolls)
keyboard: Read-only: one tab stop, with an inset focus ring from the keyboard. The arrow keys and Page Up / Page Down scroll; Mod+A selects every line, Mod+C copies; Mod+F finds; Ctrl+Shift+[ / ] (macOS Cmd+Alt+[ / ]) fold and unfold
Diff or highlighted lines: Tab reaches the code while it overflows; the arrow keys and Page Up / Page Down scroll it
Editable: one tab stop. Typing edits; Tab and Shift+Tab indent and outdent the selected lines
Editable: Escape, then Tab or Shift+Tab within two seconds, moves focus out of the editor; Ctrl+M (Shift+Alt+M on macOS) makes Tab move focus until pressed again

Editable: Mod+Z undo, Mod+Shift+Z / Mod+Y redo; Mod+D adds the next occurrence as a cursor, Alt+click adds a cursor, Alt+drag a column of cursors; Ctrl+Shift+[ / ] (macOS Cmd+Alt+[ / ]) fold and unfold

Find: Mod+F opens it with the focus in its field (again, takes the focus back to it); Enter next match, Shift+Enter previous, F3 / Mod+G and Shift+F3 / Mod+Shift+G too; Escape closes it and returns the focus to the code; editable, Enter in the replace field replaces the current match. A match already in view never scrolls the code.
notes: The text box is named by label; the gutter is aria-hidden, and line numbers are user-select: none, so selecting and copying by hand skips them; folding a range is announced.
Read-only, there is no caret; the text can be selected with the pointer and copied.
Editable, the focus shows as the caret and the current line, as in a field inside a composite surface: no ring.

In a long listing CodeMirror draws only the lines near the view, so the browser's find-in-page reaches only those; the view's own find (Mod+F) reaches every line. A diff and highlighted lines keep every line in the page.
The code is direction: ltr: it reads left to right in right-to-left pages.
The find widget's count is a polite status: it is announced as it changes. Every icon-only control is named, and its tooltip says its key.

motion: None. The current line moves and is scrolled to at once: it follows the caret, a high-frequency action.
CodeMirror arriving (read-only or editable): no motion and no shift; it takes the plain listing's scroll position.
The caret blinks as an editor's does; not with reduced motion.
Fold markers appear at once while the pointer is over the gutter; a folded line's marker always shows.
Find widget: appears and goes at once (a keyboard action, used often). The replace caret turns down over duration.move with easing.out-strong, at once from the keyboard.
